why: Everything under .github/skills must be a skill the loader can read. An entry that is not a skill is a BOOT FAILURE unless it is listed here with a reason — so silence becomes a declaration. This exists because a 5.9KB file sat in the skill root for six weeks, invisible to find_skills and to composition, while skills:verify printed it as a warning and exited 0.

entries.SkillOpt: reference notes about skill optimisation (howitwork.md, skills.md), not a skill. Either move it to docs/ or give it a SKILL.md; until then it is declared here.
